senses.gloss: रस् personal ending of the third pers. ( प्रथमपुरुष ) substituted for the affix झि in the first future ( लुट् ): cf. लुट: प्रथमस्य डारौरस: II.4.85.
रसवती name of a commentary on his own work ' Sanksiptasara Vya- karana' by KramadiSvara,a sound scholar of grammar in the thir- teenth century A.D.

रसादि a class of words headed by the word रस which have the tad.affix मतुप् added to them in the sense of possession in preference to other affixes like इन्: e.g.. रसवान् , रूपवान् etc.; cf. Kas. on P.V. 2.95.

राशि usually used in the sense of a collection or a heap or a lunar constellation; the word is often used after the word वर्ण when it means the traditional collection of letters or the alphabet. The words अक्षरराशि, त्रह्मराशि and अक्षरसमान्माय are also used in the same sense.
